sample_unit: generated summaries (200 trials x 3 audiences x 3 models)

links.outcome: NLI-based faithfulness of trial summaries with vs without knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval
links.effect: Knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval produced statistically significant improvements in NLI faithfulness scores (entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001) versus baseline; effects were small and model-dependent.
links.quote: A knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval system was developed and evaluated against the baseline, producing statistically significant improvements in NLI-based faithfulness scores (entailment +0.0125, faithfulness +0.0130, p < 0.0001).

links.outcome: Unsupported claims (hallucination) in LLM-generated clinical trial summaries
links.effect: Unsupported Claims was the dominant failure mode across all three models, mean annotation score 1.55 out of three.
links.quote: Unsupported Claims was identified as the dominant failure mode across all three models, with a mean annotation score of 1.55 out of three.

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM faithfulness in clinical trial summarization and directly compares standard prompting baseline against a knowledge-graph-augmented retrieval safeguard.
